2. Relevant facts for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that the petitioner-M/s Metalex Corporation limited, a public limited company, in course of its business, obtained loan from the respondent No. 2, Rupali Bank Limited, Ramna Corporate Branch, Dhaka (shortly, the Bank). As a security to the loan the petitioner mortgaged 1.92 acres of land situated at Tongi, Gazipur in favour of the Bank. Ultimate said loan was defaulted and the Bank, as plaintiff filed Artha Rin Suit No. 393 of 2004 before the Artha Rin Adalat No. 2, Dhaka (shortly, the Adalat) impleading the present petitioner and others as defendants for the realization of the loan amounting to Taka 16,23,86,779. Said suit was decreed on 2-2-2015 on contest. The judgment-debtor having failed to pay the decretal dues, the Bank put the decree in execution by filing Execution Case No. 397 of 2015 before the Adalat. In the execution Case, the Bank filed, an application under section 33(1) of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 to sell the mortgaged property in auction and said application was allowed by the order No. 4 dated 5-4-2016. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the said order the petitioner moved before this Court and obtained the Rule and an ad interim order of stay. 

 7. Admittedly the property mortgaged in favour of the Bank is situated at district Gazipur and the execution proceeding has been initiated and proceeded in the Artha Rin Adalat No. 2, Dhaka, the Court passed the decree, and said executing court by the impugned order invited tender for auction sale of the said mortgaged property. 

 8. The provisions of "Executing Court" of an order or decree passed in Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 has been provide in section 27 of Ain, 2003; section 27 of the Ain may be looked into which runs as follows: 

 9. From the aforesaid provisions it is evident that any order or decree passed by an Artha Rin Adalat will be executed by itself or by the Adalat before whom the order or decree is transmitted by the Adalat passed the order or decree. For said transmission no precondition has been suggested in the said provision. 

 10. As per said provision we are of the view that the execution case has lawfully filed before the Adalat, but since the mortgaged property is situated at Gazipur district the execution case ought to have been transferred to Artha Rin Adalat, Gazipur for execution of the decree relating to the mortgaged property situated at Gazipur, so that due to local publicity made by publishing auction notice, beating drums, etc., the property is sold at the maximum price. If the mortgaged property is sold at the maximum price both the Bank and the judgment debtor would be benefited by it. Therefore, the learned Judge of Artha Rin Adalat ought to have transferred the execution case to a court of Gazipur District. 

 14. The learned Judge, Artha Rin Adalat No. 2, Dhaka is hereby directed to pass necessary order to transfer the Artha Execution No. 397 to the Artha Rin Adalat, Gazipur through the District Judge for execution of the decree relating to the mortgaged property situated at Gazipur.
